answer_1.quote: We consider two longform generation tasks in our experiments: biography generation and film/book plot generation. ... We use the WikiBios and WikiPlots datasets as sources of queries and target responses.
answer_1.outputs: Long-form text such as biographies and plot summaries

answer_2.quote: We use FActScore, an automated retrieval augmentation pipeline, to evaluate the factuality of model generated responses.
automatic_metrics: FActScore (true facts count, false facts count)

answer_3.quote: FActScore ... queries GPT-3.5 to decompose a response into atomic facts and produces the factuality of each atomic fact.
